citations.title: Intel Hit With Fraud Suit for Bailing on Tower Chip Foundry Deal
excerpts: Intel Hit With Fraud Suit for Bailing on Tower Chip Foundry Deal Oct. 15, 2026, 5:45 PM UTC

Intel Corp. tricked [Tower Semiconductor Ltd.](https://www.bloomberglaw.com/company/ticker/TSEM%20IT%20Equity) into a manufacturing deal after the collapse of their planned $5.4 billion merger, then bailed on the initiative without justification, according to an unsealed fraud lawsuit. The Israeli company is suing the US tech giant over its alleged lies and failures, saying Intel’s repudiation of the manufacturing services agreement caused it hundreds of millions in harm, including more than $450 million in increased construction costs alone. The heavily redacted filing in Delaware’s Chancery Court blacks out the overall damages request.
